items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: I used to go by little Beck or Claiborne.

ctx.x: Young Polite? You see Albert Greger had a lot of fighters. Apparently he was a good trainer. And when he came in, I used to go by little Beck or Claiborne. Yeah. I mean, he was going to have lunch at 12 o'clock. And Albert told Polite, well I see y'all in the morning at the club, you know, to work out. Him and Benny left that night and went back to California to fight that match. Yeah, yeah. And Albert told him, you know, let him shape him up in about three months, maybe six months, he can go down and whip him.…
